The compilation error arises because liquibase.util.StringUtils was removed in Liquibase 4.x, as indicated by the API changes. The code uses StringUtils.trimToNull, which can be replaced with Apache Commons Lang3’s StringUtils. In Liquibase 4.x, Commons Lang3 is repackaged under liquibase.repackaged.org.apache.commons.lang3. Therefore, updating the import to liquibase.repackaged.org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils and keeping the method call unchanged will fix the compilation error. Other APIs used (e.g., supportsTablespaces) appear unaffected per the provided change list, so no other modifications are needed.
</think>

=======

>>>>>>> REPLACE
